job_description:
Responsibilities
Collaborate with data scientists, AI researchers, and business stakeholders to understand client requirements and translate them into technical specifications for AI/ML solution deployment
Design, develop, and implement robust and scalable data pipelines and AI/ML model deployment strategies utilizing cloud-based services, primarily AWS
Integrate AI/ML solutions into existing enterprise systems, ensuring seamless system integration and data flow
Utilize Agile methodologies for project execution, ensuring timely delivery and iterative development of AI/ML products
Apply principles of Systems Engineering and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) to ensure comprehensive system design, architecture, and documentation
Develop and implement automation technologies for continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD) of AI/ML models and data products
Manage project timelines, resources, and risks effectively, applying strong Project Management and Risk Management principles
Conduct thorough requirements management, ensuring solutions meet defined business needs and technical specifications
Develop and maintain clear documentation for system designs, architectures, and operational procedures
Provide technical expertise and support to clients on deployed AI/ML solutions, troubleshooting issues and ensuring optimal performance
Qualification
Python
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Cloud Computing
AI/ML Model Deployment
Data Pipelines
Systems Engineering
System Architecture
System Integration
Agile Methodology
Automation Technology
Requirements Management
Project Management
Required
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, a related quantitative field, or equivalent years of industry experience
* Proven experience with Agile Methodology in a professional environment
* Strong proficiency in Python (Programming Language) for data manipulation, scripting, and AI/ML development
* Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) for deploying and managing cloud-based services and infrastructure
* Demonstrated expertise in Cloud Computing and Cloud Based Services, particularly in the context of data and AI applications
* Solid understanding of Systems Engineering principles, including System Designs, Systems Architecture, and System Integration
* Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture Frameworks
* Proven ability in Automation Technology for deployment and operational tasks
* Strong Project Management skills with experience in managing complex technical projects
* Experience with Requirements Management and defining technical specifications
* Understanding of Risk Management principles, especially in the context of technology deployment
Preferred
* Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is a plus

high-performing AI engineering teams. Adept at bridging technical complexity with product strategy and 
business outcomes across cross-functional organizations. 
Core Skills 
 
●​
Strategic Leadership: AI Roadmapping, Cross-functional Team Scaling, Build vs. Buy Governance, Enterprise AI 
Transformation.  
●​
Agentic Systems: Multi-agent orchestration & coordination | LangGraph | Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, Memory

post-training strategies 
●​
AI & ML: Agentic framworks: Langgraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel | Interruptable voice Agent | Conversational AI 
systems | Pytorch, TensorFlow 
●​
Enterprise Architecture: Cloud Strategy (AWS/Azure/GCP), API-First Design, Legacy System Modernization 
(AS400/Mainframe).

bullets: Designed and delivered an LLM-powered marketing automation (MarTech) platform, translating stakeholder requirements into technical specifications and system architecture for production deployment.

Integrated agentic AI capabilities into existing enterprise systems, ensuring seamless system integration, governed data flow, and API-first interoperability with downstream MarTech tooling.
Drove iterative delivery using Agile methodologies, managing timelines, resources, and deployment risk while maintaining clear documentation of designs and operational procedures.
Partnered with data scientists, AI researchers, and business stakeholders to align AI roadmap and build-vs-buy decisions with measurable business outcomes.

bullets: Founded and scaled three Austin-area AI communities, growing cross-functional engineering and data science membership through structured programming and technical events.

Cultivated partnerships with enterprises and practitioners to share best practices in system architecture, automation, and responsible enterprise AI adoption.

experience.title: and AI Collective. Currently establishing the foundational framework for community

experience.title: Agentic Engineer
bullets: Architected and shipped production-grade agentic AI systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel, including interruptible voice and conversational AI agents.

Applied prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and post-training strategies with PyTorch/TensorFlow to improve agent accuracy, latency, and customer engagement.
Automated model and pipeline deployment through CI/CD-style workflows, reducing release friction and improving operational reliability of deployed AI/ML solutions.
